manifest.name: EQMOD Mount
manifest.description: Native driver for Sky-Watcher mounts (UART, USB, Bluetooth), with a mount simulator and an INDI mount proxy for PHD2 and other INDI clients.

settings.title: Settings

proxyState.pending: registered: loads when indiserver starts (first INDI device)

settings.help1: Publishes the connected mount on astrolol's indiserver as <m>{{name}}</m> (a relay to astrolol's REST API, not a real mount driver).
settings.help2: PHD2: connect to this machine's indiserver (port 7624), pick your INDI guide camera, and pick <m>astrolol Mount Proxy</m> as the mount. Guide pulses run at the mount's guide rate (connect param <m>guide_rate</m>, 0.5x sidereal by default).
settings.help3: INDI drivers that snoop a telescope (e.g. the CCD simulator's star field, or FITS headers): set their active telescope to <m>astrolol Mount Proxy</m>.

bt.title: Connect over Bluetooth
bt.intro: Pair the mount's Bluetooth serial adapter first on the <m>Bluetooth Serial</m> plugin page, then apply it below.
bt.noMount: No <m>eqmod</m> mount in your inventory yet — add one from Equipment first.
bt.currently: — currently set to the paired device <m>{{id}}</m>
bt.saved: Saved. Reconnect the mount (or reload the profile) for it to take effect.

page.title: EQMOD
page.howto: Equipment → Load driver → Mount → Other adapter → <m>eqmod</m>, with params <m>{{params}}</m>. Add <m>"baudrate"</m> to skip auto-detection (9600 for an EQMOD cable, 115200 for the AZ-EQ6 built-in USB), and <m>"ra_reverse"</m> / <m>"dec_reverse"</m> if a nudge moves the wrong way.
